records.title: Mystics in Bali
records.meta: Film · Indonesia · Indonesian/English · dir. Tjut Djalil · aka Mistik (Punahnya Rahasia Ilmu Iblis Leak)
records.mechanism: Hypnotic mark / black magic of a Leák witch
records.summary: Cathy, an American woman researching black magic in Bali, lets a Leák witch train her. The witch tricks her, hypnotises her through the mark, and turns her into a flying-head vampire that serves the witch.
records.pregnancy_note: No pregnancy in the plot summaries.
records.kids_note: No children of hers in the sources; she is unmarried with a boyfriend (Mahendra).
records.evidence: Mental Block plot + gallery; Wikipedia plot

records.title: Pelet Tali Pocong
records.meta: Film · Indonesia · Indonesian · dir. Dedy Mercy · MD Pictures
records.summary: Adam, a worker at a tea factory, is rejected and humiliated by the factory's owner, the widow Susan. He performs the pelet tali pocong ritual and takes control of her heart, her wealth and the factory, while the village is terrorised by pocong ghosts and the local ustaz suspects him.
records.kids_note: Synopses say only that she is a widow; children not mentioned.

records.title: Pemikat Jiwa
records.meta: Film · Indonesia · Indonesian · dir. Dom Dharmo · released 9 Jul 2026
records.mechanism: Pemikat Jiwa ('soul enchantment') pelet ritual controlling her emotions and desires
records.summary: Chicken butcher Jay is obsessed with Wulan, who is engaged to another man. After she rejects him he uses a forbidden pelet ritual to control her emotions; it seems to work at first, but a dark presence attaches itself to Wulan and the spell turns into possession and terror.
records.kids_note: Engaged, not married; children not mentioned.

records.title: Tarkan: Altın Madalyon
records.meta: Film · Turkey · Turkish · dir. Mehmet Aslan · aka Tarkan: The Golden Medallion
records.mechanism: Hypnotic gaze of the vampire witch Gosha
records.summary: While Tarkan and friends try to rescue Attila's kidnapped son, Kulka's wife Erka is hypnotised by the vampire witch Gosha; in a trance she leaves the child she was protecting and walks into a giant spider web where she is trapped.

records.title: Mind Thief
records.meta: Film · USA · English · dir. Matt Steinauer
records.mechanism: Coded notes and hypnotic programming in a secret mind-control program
records.summary: Struggling novelist Christine discovers that her new neighbour Walter and her ex Nathan are using her as the first test subject of a brainwashing plot: in a trance she writes coded notes that program her hypnotised neighbours, with the goal of brainwashing the wealthy Stacy Burke into funding the project. Neighbour Dolores is also programmed.
